kitchen.title: Kitchen display
kitchen.subtitle: Tickets sent from the floor — mark items ready when prepared.
kitchen.stop_desc: Stop a dish when an ingredient is missing. Waiters cannot order it until you resume it.
kitchen.stop_ok: Waiters can no longer order this dish.
kitchen.resume_ok: Waiters can order this dish again.
kitchen.stop_enforce_off: Kitchen-stop blocking is off (Settings → Inventory & stock rules). Stopped dishes are hidden from the waiter menu on the monitor and phone.
kitchen.stop_enforce_on: Waiters on the monitor and phone cannot order a stopped dish — they see a notification instead.
kitchen.load_failed: Could not load the kitchen queue.
kitchen.supabase_required: Supabase is not configured (URL / anon key). Kitchen display needs a connected database.
menu.item_station_required: Choose Kitchen or Bar. Every product needs a station so tickets print to the right place.
menu.supply_subtitle_kitchen: Kitchen inventory — not a plated dish. Enter name, vendor, expiry, and quantity.
menu.supply_subtitle_bar: Bar inventory — mixers, garnishes, etc. Add vendor, lot, and storage.
menu.supply_station_hint_kitchen: Tied to the kitchen for tickets and reports.
menu.supply_station_hint_bar: Tied to the bar for tickets and reports.
menu.supply_details_toggle_hint: Vendor, invoice, expiry, and where it is stored.
menu.supply_quick_pick_hint: Tap an ingredient — name and unit fill in; then set quantity and save.
menu.recipe_section_hint: Per each portion sold, deduct these amounts from tracked supply items (Furnizim). Quantities use each ingredient’s stock unit (e.g. 0.2 for 200 g when the row is in kg).
menu.recipe_no_supply_items: Add tracked supply rows under category Furnizim (Mall) first — then they appear here.
menu.customization_option_name: Option name (e.g. Well done, No salad)
menu.prep_hint: These options open full screen on the waiter phone when they tap the pencil. Leave empty to use the category defaults.
menu.prep_hint_category: Default for every product in this category. A product can override this in its own edit screen.
menu.prep_choice_hint: e.g. Temperature: Cold, Normal, No ice
menu.prep_toggles_hint: e.g. No mushrooms, no onions, no salad. These never increase the price.
menu.prep_paid_extras_hint: Only items the customer adds to the product that increase its price: extra vegetables, salad, sauce, or cheese.
menu.prep_allow_custom_instructions: Allow waiter to add a preparation request
menu.prep_allow_custom_instructions_hint: Lets the waiter write a free request about preparation for this order only.
menu.prep_quick_hint: Only extras with a price, e.g. extra sauce or extra spicy. Removals like no mushrooms belong in free modifications.
menu.no_categories_hint: No categories yet. Create a category first.
menu.label_staff_meal_allow: Allow this item for staff meals
menu.hint_staff_meal_daily_unlimited: Leave empty for no daily limit
menu.hint_staff_meal_first_free: Example: 1 = first portion free, extra portions use the staff price
menu.err_staff_meal_daily_limit: Enter a valid daily limit (1 or more), or leave empty
menu.err_staff_meal_free_qty: Free portions cannot be more than the daily limit
menu.err_staff_meal_price: Please enter a valid staff meal price
staff_consumption.title: Staff consumption
staff_consumption.description_select: Choose how to identify the staff member
staff_consumption.admin_rules_hint: Prices and daily limits are set by the admin on each product.
support.priority_body: Professional plan: we prioritise your messages. Email us with your licence key and issue.
order.split_restrict_hint: Use No receipt or Non-fiscal until the balance is cleared. Fiscal and debt apply to the full remaining balance.
order.split_pick_hint: Tap a line to pay 1 unit. Use + / − if you need more of the same item.
order.split_pick_empty: Select at least one line to pay.
order.split_pick_over: Selected total is more than the balance due.
order.pay_bill_type_choose: Choose how to settle this order
order.pay_drawer_choose_method: Choose a payment method to complete the order
order.cash_confirmed_body: The cashier confirmed the cash. This table is now paid and closed.
order.cash_confirmed_partial_body: This portion is paid. The remaining balance stays open on the table.
order.cash_need_received: Enter the cash received before completing payment.
order.card_step_wait_sub: Tap, insert or swipe the card on the terminal
order.card_footer_hint: Keep this window open until the terminal finishes.
order.pay_type_fiscal_desc: Official taxable sale with fiscal printer
order.pay_type_no_receipt_desc: Clear table, save to database only
order.pay_type_debt_desc: Charge to customer or company account
starter_overview.title: Starter Overview
starter_overview.subtitle: Only essential metrics for Starter plan.
msg.kitchen_plan_required: Kitchen display requires the Professional plan.
order.pay_not_allowed: This role cannot take payment at the counter.
pos_view.crash_body: Your last action may still be saved. Use Retry, or reload the app if the problem continues.
expense_shift_hint: Costs you pay for the business during your shift. They clear when a manager closes your shift and appear on the printed shift report.
expense_placeholder: e.g. Supplies for the bar, ice, lemons…
common.name: Name
common.offline_action_queued: Saved offline. Will sync when back online.
common.need_online_for_upload: Connect to the internet to upload images.
floor.pending_payments_empty: No bills waiting at the counter.
order.customization_desc: Choose the options for this item.
order.return_item_hint: Return unused units. They will not be deducted from stock.
order.return_item_desc: Return {{name}}. Unused product stays in stock.
order.delete_reason_hint: Choose why this item is waste. Stock will be deducted.
order.delete_reason_desc: {{name}} will be removed from the order.
order.delete_stock_note: Tracked products leave stock. Never below zero.
order.replace_item_hint: Choose a replacement from the menu.
order.replace_item_desc: Replace {{name}} with another product. Choose how many units to swap.
order.replace_item_desc_swap: Swap {{name}} with another product. It has not been sent yet, so it will not look deleted.
order.replace_item_desc_return: {{name}} was already sent. Replacing it will return/void those units and send the new product.
order.order_sent: Order sent: {{kitchen}} to Kitchen, {{bar}} to Bar
staff_meal.no_allowed_items: No products are enabled for staff meals. Ask a manager to turn on “Allow this item for staff meals” and set the staff price and daily quantity on each product.
staff_meal.limit_exceeded: {{name}} is limited to {{limit}} per day for staff
staff_meal.not_allowed: {{name}} is not enabled for staff meals
order.print_popup_blocked: Could not print the ticket. On desktop: set a default printer in Windows (Settings → Printers). In a browser: allow pop-ups for this site.
order.print_ticket_silent_failed: The ticket did not reach the printer. Check that it is on, connected, and set as the default printer in Windows.
order.print_no_physical_printer: No physical printer was found (only PDF/virtual drivers). Install your receipt printer, don’t rely on “Microsoft Print to PDF alone, then set the real printer as default in Windows.
order.print_ticket_error: Could not print the ticket. Try again or use the desktop app for direct printing.
order.bill_offline: Connect to the internet to print the bill
order.transfer_help: Move this bill to an empty table.
order.merge_help: Add this bill’s items to another table that already has an open bill.
order.no_merge_targets: No other table with an open bill
order.cart_blocks_table_move: Send or clear new items in the cart first
order.err_add_items_first: Add items to the order first
order.offline_queue_info: Order queued for when back online
order.blocked_stopped: {{name}} is unavailable — the kitchen stopped it.
order.err_send_server: Could not send the order on the server. Menu is local only until Convex or Supabase orders are connected.
order.debt_credit_warning: Warning: This will put {{name}} at {{newBalance}} — over their {{limit}} credit limit
order.fiscal_print_failed: Payment saved but the fiscal receipt did not print. Check the printer or Templates → Fiscal Receipt.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.enterprise_subtitle: Venue analysis — revenue, stations, and live operations at a glance.
dashboard.overview_subtitle: A clear view of your venue’s sales and performance.
dashboard.calendar_filter_hint: All dashboard figures are based on this calendar day.
dashboard.calendar_range_hint: Tap a start day, then an end day.
dashboard.reports_subtitle: Export Excel or PDF, and email reports on a schedule.
dashboard.reports_pdf_ready: Print dialog opened — save as PDF
dashboard.reports_schedule_hint: POS sends the report when this screen is open after the scheduled time.
dashboard.reports_send_failed: Could not send the email. Export still works.
dashboard.reports_admin_only: Only an admin can create scheduled emails.
dashboard.reports_sql_missing: Run supabase/ensure_dashboard_report_schedules.sql in Supabase, then try again.
dashboard.circulation_total_hint: Paid so far + still open tables
dashboard.circulation_unpaid_hint: Tables still open in the room / terrace
dashboard.enterprise_profit_note: Estimate based on tracked stock valuation and recorded expenses.
dashboard.enterprise_forecast_hint: Forecast uses today's pace from 08:00 to midnight.
dashboard.enterprise_target_period_hint: The target scales with the selected number of days.
dashboard.enterprise_target_empty_hint: Set a daily target to track sales progress and pace.
dashboard.enterprise_target_save_failed: The target could not be saved.
dashboard.target_pulse_starts_today: Tracking starts today and includes paid orders only.
dashboard.target_pulse_keeps_start: The original start date stays unchanged.
dashboard.target_pulse_empty_hint: Choose an amount and a deadline to start tracking.
dashboard.target_pulse_admin_only: Only an admin can create the revenue target.
dashboard.target_pulse_invalid_amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
dashboard.target_pulse_invalid_date: Choose a valid future end date.
dashboard.target_pulse_save_failed: Target Pulse could not be saved.
dashboard.stock_notifications_empty: No items are out of stock
dashboard.stock_notifications_empty_hint: New stock shortages will appear here.
dashboard.inventory_alerts_count: {{count}} items are running low on stock
dashboard.system_status_subtitle: Live diagnostics for this POS device and connected services.
dashboard.system_status_printer_not_foun: The configured printer was not found in Windows
dashboard.system_status_printer_desktop_: Automatic checks require the desktop app
dashboard.system_status_printer_check_fa: Windows could not read the printer status
dashboard.system_status_prints_pending: {{count}} print jobs are waiting to retry
dashboard.system_status_internet_offline: This device is not connected to the internet
dashboard.system_status_cloud_offline: Sync is waiting for an internet connection
dashboard.system_status_cloud_error: Could not connect to Vyntex Cloud
dashboard.system_status_reset_failed: Reset failed. Check the device and try again.
dashboard.revenue_overview_calendar_hint: Choose a date to view its Monday–Sunday week.
dashboard.sales_by_category_subtitle: Revenue mix for the selected period
dashboard.top_products_cost_unavailable: Add a recipe and supply costs to calculate profit.
dashboard.staff_performance_subtitle: Revenue ranking for the selected period
dashboard.top5_products_subtitle: Quantity and revenue from top-selling products
dashboard.starter_payments_sub: Cash and card totals for the selected day.
dashboard.subtitle: Revenue by day, week, month, and year — tap a period for payment breakdown, top items, and staff
dashboard.sales_trend_subtitle: Paid revenue in this view · % vs prior window
dashboard.popular_times_sub: Revenue by day and hourly order traffic
dashboard.popular_times_empty: No activity for this day yet
dashboard.week_activity_sub: Paid sales totals for the last seven calendar days
dashboard.week_activity_empty: No paid sales recorded in this period
dashboard.supply_chart_sub: Current inventory value and the last six months of stock intake and usage. Profitability is summarized in the section above.
dashboard.revenue_share_sub: Top items by revenue in the selected period
dashboard.donut_empty: No revenue data for this period
dashboard.chart_hint: Solid: this window · Dashed: same-length period before (comparison)
dashboard.chart_empty: No paid sales in this view
dashboard.empty_staff: No staff activity in this period
dashboard.other_paid_hint: {{count}} other paid order in this period (debt, complimentary, …) — see payment type above.
dashboard.other_paid_hint_plural: {{count}} other paid orders in this period (debt, complimentary, …) — see payment type above.
dashboard.bulk_subtitle: Select orders to fiscalize in batch
dashboard.bulk_toast_skip: All selected orders were already fiscalized
home.subtitle: POS overview
home.action_floor_desc: View and arrange your table layout
home.action_menu_desc: Add or edit categories and items
home.action_tables_desc: Set up zones and table layout
home.action_floor_waiter_desc: See table status and select a table
home.action_orders_desc: See active orders on the floor
staff.pin_new_optional: New PIN (leave empty to keep current)
staff.pin_not_recoverable_hint: Saved PINs are stored securely (one-way) and cannot be shown. Leave empty to keep the current PIN, or type a new one — use the eye to show characters while typing.
staff.admin_all_permissions_hint: Admins & managers have all permissions enabled by default
staff.perm_void_desc: Can void or remove order items
staff.perm_transfer_desc: Move the open bill to a table with no open bill
staff.perm_merge_desc: Combine this bill with another table that already has an open bill
staff.perm_split_desc: Can split the bill into partial payments
staff.perm_menu_desc: Can add, edit, or remove menu items
staff.perm_stock_desc: Can update inventory and stock levels
staff.perm_consumption_desc: Can log meals/drinks consumed by staff
staff.perm_debt_desc: Can charge the current order to a customer account (next to sent items)
staff.perm_complimentary_desc: Can mark the current order complimentary (admin PIN required)
staff.perm_audit_desc: Can open the audit trail (activity: who did what)
staff.err_pin_digits: PIN must be between {{min}} and {{max}} characters (letters or numbers)
settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage printers, peripherals, company details, and receipt templates
settings.cat.general_desc: Business information, address, phone, currency, language, and timezone
settings.general_lead: Business profile, regional preferences, and default POS settings.
settings.tips_autosave: Language, currency, and timezone save as soon as you change them. Use Edit to change business name, address, and phone.
settings.last_updated_live: Settings are live on this terminal.
settings.cat.payments_desc: How bills are paid — at the table or at the counter
settings.pay_lead: Configure how payments are made in your restaurant.
settings.pay_methods_lead: Choose which payment methods are available on the POS and (optionally) on the phone app.
settings.pay_pos_info: Methods available on the POS till / monitor.
settings.pay_phone_info: Methods shown in the waiter phone app. The till still closes the bill.
settings.pay_perm_lead: Select which roles are allowed to make payments.
settings.payment_handling: How are payments handled in your venue?
settings.payment_handling_desc: Payments are verified and recorded at the till.
settings.payment_phone_note: The waiter phone takes orders and requests the bill; it cannot close payments.
settings.payment_mode_waiter_lead: The waiter takes payment at the table.
settings.payment_mode_waiter_1: Waiter can choose Cash / Card / QR
settings.payment_mode_waiter_3: Payment is recorded from the waiter’s phone
settings.payment_mode_counter_lead: Controlled flow: Cash or Card is verified and recorded at the till.
settings.payment_mode_counter_3: The till sees the bill under Pending Payments
settings.payment_mode_counter_4: Only authorized counter staff can take payment and close the table
settings.payment_counter_who: Who can process payments at the counter?
settings.payment_counter_who_desc: Applies to the POS till. Waiter phones still cannot close tables in this mode.
settings.payment_methods_desc: Which methods the till can record: Cash or Card.
settings.payment_methods_one: Keep at least one payment method on.
settings.payment_critical_desc: Refunds and other critical changes can only be turned on or off by an administrator.
settings.payment_split_desc: Staff with split-bill permission can split a table’s bill (plan allowing).
settings.payment_refund_desc: When off, only an administrator can void items. When on, managers can too.
settings.payment_close_table_waiter: Waiters close the table when they collect payment on the phone.
settings.payment_close_table_counter: Only the roles checked above can take payment and close the table at the till.
settings.manager_payments_hint: You can change who collects payment, payment methods, and counter roles. Split bill and refunds need an administrator.
settings.cat.menu_desc: Menu products, categories, variants, modifiers, combo meals, and availability
settings.menu_lead: These cards open the Menu module. Products are saved only there — Settings does not keep a second product editor.
settings.menu_link_desc: Add, edit, and manage menu items, prices, and details.
settings.menu_categories_desc: Create and organize categories, such as burgers, pizza, and drinks.
settings.menu_variants_desc: Set product options like size, portion, or cooking level (for example S / M / L).
settings.menu_modifiers_desc: Add extras and changes on the product, such as extra cheese or no onion, with or without a price.
settings.menu_combo_desc: Create a combined meal as one product in Menu, with its own price.
settings.menu_availability_desc: Turn menu items on or off in the menu list.
settings.menu_station_desc: Choose where a product is prepared so tickets go to the kitchen or the bar.
settings.cat.devices_desc: USB, IP, and Bluetooth printers, routing, test print, queue, and errors. Document design is in Print layout.
settings.cat.users_desc: Staff accounts, PIN login, roles, permissions, and role-change audit
settings.cat.tax_desc: VAT number, country tax rates, inclusive/exclusive pricing, and product tax assignment
settings.cat.notifications_desc: Manage in-app, email, and SMS notifications
settings.cat.integrations_desc: Accounting, delivery, payment gateways, and API or webhooks — only with a real connection status
settings.int_lead: External services show a real connection status. If a connector is not shipped, it is marked unavailable — there is no Connect button that does nothing.
settings.int_cat_accounting_lead: Export sales, tax, and expenses to accounting software.
settings.int_cat_delivery_lead: Receive delivery-platform orders into this POS.
settings.int_cat_payments_lead: Card terminals and online gateways that settle into Vyntex POS.
settings.int_cat_api_lead: Public API keys and outbound webhooks for this venue, when they are supported.
settings.int_accounting_desc: No accounting connector is live for this POS yet.
settings.int_accounting_setup: When a connector ships, you will enter the provider credentials here (company ID and API key from that accounting product). Until then this stays unavailable.
settings.int_delivery_desc: No Glovo, Wolt, or other delivery connector is live for this POS yet.
settings.int_delivery_setup: When a connector ships, you will paste the store ID and API token from that delivery platform. Until then this stays unavailable.
settings.int_payments_desc: Card in POS is recorded on this till. There is no live payment-gateway connector (Stripe, terminal SDK, or similar) to connect here.
settings.int_payments_setup: When a gateway ships, you will enter merchant ID and terminal credentials from that provider. Cash and card on the till stay in Payment Management.
settings.int_api_desc: This POS does not expose a public venue API or outbound webhooks yet.
settings.int_api_setup: When API access ships, this page will show an API key, webhook URL, and signing secret. Do not create dummy URLs until that exists.
settings.int_errors_none: No connection errors. A live session has not been opened.
settings.int_actions_hidden: Reconnect and Disconnect appear only after a real connector is live.
settings.int_actions_ready: Use Reconnect or Disconnect for this live connector.
settings.cat.inventory_desc: What happens when an item has no stock, kitchen stop, and deduction
settings.cat.storage_desc: Data storage, offline queue, and recovery — not stock rules
settings.store_backup_lead: A scheduled copy of venue data for restore. This is not the offline queue on this terminal.
settings.store_last_backup_none: No backup has run. Cloud backup is not live for venues yet.
settings.store_restore_unavailable: Restore will appear here only after cloud backup is live. There is no restore action on this terminal.
settings.store_queue_lead: Actions saved in IndexedDB on this device until they reach the cloud. This queue is not a backup of the restaurant.
settings.store_queue_offline: This terminal is offline. New actions stay in the local queue.
settings.store_sync_lead: When this POS last reached the cloud. Sync is not a backup snapshot.
settings.store_recovery_cloud: Orders, menu, staff, and settings live in the cloud. This terminal keeps a local cache so POS can work without internet.
settings.store_recovery_queue: If the internet drops, unsynced actions wait in the offline queue on this device. They are replayed when the connection returns.
settings.store_recovery_device: If this device is lost before the queue syncs, those local actions may be lost. Cloud data already saved stays available on other terminals.
settings.availability_admin_only: Only an administrator can change this setting.
settings.inv_oos_lead: Choose whether waiters can still sell a tracked item when quantity is zero. This applies on the POS monitor and the waiter phone.
settings.inv_block_oos: Block order when item is out of stock
settings.inv_block_oos_desc: Waiters cannot add or send the item. It stays visible but greyed on the monitor, phone, and kitchen stop list.
settings.inv_allow_oos_desc: Waiters can still sell the item. Stock may go negative until it is adjusted in Stock.
settings.inv_kitchen_lead: When kitchen or bar marks an item unavailable, the same state is used on the monitor, phone, and kitchen.
settings.inv_kitchen_on: Stopped items stay on the waiter menu, greyed. Ordering is blocked with a notification.
settings.inv_kitchen_off: Stopped items are hidden from waiter menus on the monitor and phone instead of blocked with a notice.
settings.inv_threshold_lead: Default threshold for low stock alerts, used when an item has no custom threshold.
settings.inv_threshold_label: Warn when quantity is at or below
settings.inv_deduct_lead: Stock falls when the order is sent. It does not fall when the order is created or when the bill is paid.
settings.inv_deduct_send_desc: Tracked item quantity is deducted when the waiter sends the order, not when the bill is paid.
settings.inv_deduct_recipe_desc: If a dish has a supply recipe, ingredients are deducted on send together with the dish.
settings.inv_stock_jump: Count, adjust, and review stock history. When an item hits zero, the rule above decides if waiters can still sell it.
settings.inv_page_lead: What happens when quantity is zero, and when the kitchen marks an item unavailable.
settings.inv_preview_lead: An example of the rules on this page. This is not a live menu item.
settings.inv_preview_blocked_desc: A tracked item at zero cannot be added or sent.
settings.inv_preview_allowed_desc: A tracked item at zero can still be sold. Stock can go below zero.
settings.cat.security_desc: Sessions, authorized devices, login history, and account protection
settings.sec_sessions_lead: PIN session on this terminal, plus other POS terminals that are online. Waiter phones are managed in Phone app.
settings.sec_this_terminal: Signed in on this POS terminal
settings.sec_sessions_empty: No other POS terminals are online.
settings.sec_revoke_ok: That terminal was signed out. It must enter the license key again.
settings.sec_revoke_self: Use Log out on this terminal to end this session.
settings.sec_cloud_admin: Signing out other terminals requires a cloud Admin or Manager PIN. A known Device ID is not enough, and the local device-admin PIN cannot revoke terminals.
settings.sec_devices_lead: POS terminals registered on this license. A Device ID by itself cannot open the till — staff must sign in with PIN.
settings.sec_timeout_lead: After this idle time, this terminal returns to the PIN screen. Other terminals are not closed automatically.
settings.sec_pin_lead: Staff sign in with a PIN of {{min}}–{{max}} letters or digits. There is no password login on the POS till.
settings.sec_pin_users: Change PINs in Users & Roles. Roles are not managed on this page.
settings.sec_2fa_lead: POS PIN login does not support 2FA. There is no Enable button until a second factor is built for the till.
settings.sec_failed_none: No failed PIN attempts in the recent log.
settings.sec_events_lead: Voids, staff changes, sign-ins, and terminal revokes from the audit log.
settings.sec_admin_only: Only an administrator can change this setting.
settings.sec_device_id_note: Authorization is checked on the server with an Admin or Manager staff account. Knowing a Device ID is not enough to use or revoke a terminal.
settings.cat.print_desc: What prints and how it looks. Printer connections stay in Printers & Devices.
settings.cat.customer_display_desc: What the guest screen shows during the order and payment. Pairing is a second monitor or window — not the phone app.
settings.cd_lead: This is the screen the customer sees. USB printers and waiter phones are not configured here.
settings.cd_enable_desc: When off, the guest screen stays closed even if a second monitor is plugged in.
settings.cd_hint_window: A customer display window is open. Drag it onto the guest screen if it is on this computer.
settings.cd_hint_detected: A second screen is available. Pair it to open the guest display there.
settings.cd_hint_no_screen: No second screen is plugged in. Connect a customer monitor, then Pair. This page will not show Active until that window is open.
settings.cd_hint_browser: Pair opens a window on this computer. Move it to the customer screen. Fullscreen on a second monitor needs the desktop app.
settings.cd_no_screen: No second screen was found. Plug in a customer monitor, then try Pair again.
settings.cd_popup_blocked: The browser blocked the guest window. Allow pop-ups for this site, then Pair again.
settings.cd_pair_failed: The customer display could not be opened.
settings.cd_show_subtotal_desc: Net amount before tax on the guest screen.
settings.cd_show_tax_desc: VAT / tax line on the guest screen.
settings.cd_show_change_desc: Displayed when cash tendered is more than the amount due.
settings.cd_welcome_lead: Shown when the display is connected and no order is open.
settings.cd_lang_lead: Labels on the guest screen. This does not change the POS till language.
settings.cd_promo_lead: Scheduled ads on the guest screen are not built yet. There is no Enable button until a promotion player exists.
settings.cd_admin_only: Only an administrator can change this setting.
settings.cat.phone_app_desc: Waiter phones: activation, QR pairing, devices, and the waiter app look. Printers and security stay in their own pages.
settings.phone_app_lead: Manage the phones waiters use to open Vyntex POS. Printers, till security, and license billing are not configured here.
settings.phone_app_devices_lead: Device name, Device ID, last seen, and whether the phone may still take new actions.
settings.phone_app_devices_empty: No waiter phones have been paired yet. Scan the QR above on the phone.
settings.phone_app_revoke_ok: This phone can no longer take new actions.
settings.phone_app_repair_ok: Access revoked. Scan the new QR on the phone to pair it again.
settings.phone_app_waiters_lead: Staff who can sign in on a paired phone. Inactive accounts in Users & Roles cannot start a shift.
settings.phone_app_waiters_empty: No waiter, cashier, manager, or admin accounts yet.
settings.phone_app_session_lead: The pairing QR expires after 15 minutes. A waiter shift on the phone lasts until they sign out or close the app. Revoking a phone ends authorization immediately — the old pairing cannot send new orders.
settings.cat.other_desc: Light/dark theme, program version, and desktop updates. Stock, backup, payments, and billing stay on their own pages.
settings.cat.license_desc: Current plan, license status, remaining time, and included features. Invoices and license payments are managed on the website.
settings.sys_page_lead: Manage the program appearance, version, updates, and system information.
settings.sys_appearance_lead: Choose how Vyntex POS looks on this device.
settings.sys_night_desc: Dark and easy on the eyes.
settings.sys_version_card_lead: Check for a new version, download the update, and install it if available.
settings.sys_notes_sub: What's new in the latest version.
settings.sys_diag_sub: Create a diagnostic report from this device for support and troubleshooting.
settings.sys_diag_note: The report includes version, runtime, last check, and queue number. It does not include PIN, token, or license key.
settings.sys_install_rules: Install & Restart works only in the installed desktop application. In the browser, Download update saves the installer. In a development session, in-place update is not installed.
settings.sys_update_lead_desktop: This installed desktop app is compared with the latest published installer. Download, then Install & Restart.
settings.sys_update_lead_web: This browser session is compared with the latest published version. Desktop install happens from the Windows installer, not inside the tab.
settings.sys_status_dev: Desktop update needs the installed app
settings.sys_install_web_hint: Install & Restart is for the Windows desktop app. Here, Download update saves the installer.
settings.sys_notes_lead: No release notes are available for this version.
settings.sys_info_lead: Details about this device and how the program is running.
settings.sys_diag_lead: Downloads a diagnostic report from this device: version, runtime, last update check, and queue counts. It does not include PINs, tokens, or license keys.
